name: Gertrude Adams Remy
notable_stories: Known for her physical likeness to her grandmother Serena
After losing her son Christopher in a motorcycle accident and her husband to cancer, she became somewhat reclusive but remained close to her brother John, traveling to Scotland with him in 2010
Named 'Gertrude' after Beryl's grandmother; 'Elaine' after Beryl's sister Elaine (Elaine Deretha Simons).
After losing son Christopher at 21, then mother Beryl, then husband Mike at 59 — drove into an extended period of personal and emotional isolation.
'Now, though she is loving and caring, she is almost finished fighting with what I think she stubbornly considers to be a downward spiral.'
'Fortunately for her she has the constant care of her daughter and grandkids.' — referring to Camille Remy Obad and her children.
When John and Barbara visit Trudy, they only stay a few days. 'I see my mother as she was aging, in her.'
career: Trudy, John and George were all retired by 2011.
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Older sister of John Howard Adams
Siblings listed: John Howard Adams, George Francis Adams Jr.
Named after Beryl's grandmother (name still unknown) and Beryl's sister Elaine Deretha Simons.

CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Removed a block of family-wide places (Posen, Battle Creek, Honolulu, Tacoma …) that had been copied onto 48 records; kept only those that belong to this person: Battle Creek, MI; San Francisco, CA; Fair Oaks, CA.
Unconfirmed: Trudy apparently lived in or near Sacramento in 2011; the trip to Trudy's meant driving down to Sacramento. [Family research emails, email 33]

Open question: When did George Francis Adams (#2) die? Trudy (Gertrude Adams Remy) says 1918, when their dad was 2. The 1920 Douglas County, OR census (dated 20 Jan 1920) lists him, and his NARD Journal obituary gives 7 Feb and was published 18 Mar 1920. The writers want the Douglas County death certificate to settle it. [Family research emails, email 30, 31, 20, 18]
